title: RFP - Joint Counter Intelligence Training Activity
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE INTELLIGENCE AGENCY (DIA).VIRGINIA CONTRACTING ACTIVITY
detail_text: This is a special notice of The Virginia Contracting Activity (VACA) release of a RFP for Joint Counter intelligence Training Activity on NSA ARC. Please take note of the following: - RFP submission deadline: April 25, 2026, at 23:59 PM (EST) - All qualified entities wishing to respond to the Request for Proposal (RFP) must comply with the instructions outlined in the NSA ARC posting. - Additionally, access to the NSA ARC is a prerequisite for RFP submission. - Secondary POC : Maxwell Massari, maxwell.massari@dodiis.mil, 202-231-2670
